points: The bride calls herself the rose of Sharon and the lily of the valleys, and among the daughters she is as the lily among thorns.

points: She answers that as the apple tree is among the trees of the wood, so is her beloved among the sons; she sat under his shadow with great delight and his fruit was sweet to her taste.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: He brought her to the banqueting house and his banner over her was love; she asks to be stayed with flagons and comforted with apples, for she is sick of love.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: His left hand is under her head and his right hand embraces her; she charges the daughters of Jerusalem by the roes and the hinds of the field not to stir up nor awake her love until he please.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: The voice of her beloved comes leaping upon the mountains and skipping upon the hills, like a roe or a young hart.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: He stands behind their wall, looking forth at the windows and showing himself through the lattice.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: Her beloved speaks and calls her to rise up and come away, for the winter is past, the rain is over and gone.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: The flowers appear on the earth, the time of the singing of birds is come, the voice of the turtle is heard, the fig tree puts forth her green figs and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: He calls her his dove in the clefts of the rock and the secret places of the stairs, asking to see her countenance and hear her voice, for sweet is her voice and her countenance comely.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: He calls to take the little foxes that spoil the vines, for their vines have tender grapes.

note.label: Song of Solomon 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Voice of My Beloved

points: She declares her beloved is hers and she is his; he feeds among the lilies until the day break and the shadows flee away.
